mentions.name: Positron
mentions.description: A data science IDE built on VS Code with robust support for both Python and R workflows, with roots in RStudio.
mentions.problem: Making VS Code a competent R/Python data environment requires installing a bunch of extensions.
mentions.audience: VS Code users who want a competent R/Python data environment
mentions.source_excerpt: Positron, a data science IDE. Has roots in RStudio but it's built on VS Code and has robust support for both Python and R workflows. If you use VS Code and install a bunch of extensions to try to make it a competent R/Python data environment, you'll probably love Positron.

evidence.value: Positron, a data science IDE. Has roots in RStudio but it's built on VS Code and has robust support for both Python and R workflows. If you use VS Code and install a bunch of extensions to try to make it a competent R/Python data environment, you'll probably love Positron.
